Dust & Rice

The current version returns to the original simple geometric art style. Characters, scenery, and hit effects use small flat-colored meshes. The imported character models, scanned materials, and textured tree packs from the previous version are no longer loaded or shipped.

Rendering uses Three.js and its Projector utility, under the MIT license. The compatibility renderer draws colored triangles on Canvas without sampling textures on the CPU.

The rural Chinese setting and characters are fictional.
